theorem typedTerms_original (sig : Signature Op) (ts : Terms) :
    (cata_terms (PrintEliminators.termAlg sig) ts).1 = ts :=
  (hom_eq_cata_terms (typedOriginalHom sig) ts).trans (cata_id_terms ts)

removed_blocks.block:
theorem eraseTerms_printTerms (sig : Signature Op) (ts : Terms) (env : TyEnv) (const : Bool)
    {xs : List Expr} (hp : (cata_terms (PrintEliminators.termAlg sig) ts).2 env const = .ok xs) :
    xs.map (eraseTerm env.length) = printTerms env.length ts := by
  have h := (cata_terms (typedCertificateAlg sig) ts).property env const xs
  have folded := hom_eq_cata_terms (typedCertificateHom sig) ts
  change (cata_terms (typedCertificateAlg sig) ts).val = cata_terms (PrintEliminators.termAlg sig) ts at folded
  rw [folded] at h
  have result := h hp
  rw [typedTerms_original] at result
  exact result
